_meta.description: SP6→9 REDIRECT — small gap (20pts), Stage 4 both lean to Type 9, swap fires, alternate becomes Type 6. Exercises Defect #2b (Call #2 prompt names redirect_from_type as the alternate) and, after the runner replays applyCall2DeterministicStamps, the engine swap (Defect #2) end-to-end. confirmed_type 9, redirect_from_type 6, alternate_candidate swapped to 6, confirmed_type !== alternate_candidate.

stage0Answers.q1: loyal, careful, a bit anxious — I think through what could go wrong so the people I'm responsible for are covered, and I stick by my commitments even when it's hard
stage0Answers.q2: dependable, conscientious, sometimes a worrier; the person others trust to have a plan B
stage0Answers.q3: preparation and loyalty — I anticipate problems before they happen and I don't bail on people when things get difficult
stage0Answers.q4: doubt — I second-guess myself and the people around me, and I can get stuck scanning for threats instead of just trusting that things will be okay

stage1TypeOpen: My mind is always running worst-case scenarios — not because I'm negative, but because if I've prepared for it, it can't blindside me or the people counting on me. I have a complicated relationship with authority: I want something solid to trust, but part of me is always testing whether it actually deserves my trust.
stage1InstinctOpen: Security is everything to me — I keep a buffer in savings, I know where the exits are, and I don't like depending on anyone for the basics. I'd rather over-prepare my own resources than get caught needing something I don't have.
